statements.query: MATCH ((n:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (rule:AzureNetworkSecurityRule)<-[:CONTAIN]-(group:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE rule.access = 'Allow' AND rule.direction = 'Inbound' AND (rule.source_address_prefix IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', 'Internet'] OR any(p IN coalesce(rule.source_address_prefixes, []) WHERE p IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', 'Internet'])) SET group.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_ipv4' IN coalesce(group.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN group END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(group.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'direct_ipv4';

MATCH (rule:AzureNetworkSecurityRule)<-[:CONTAIN]-(group:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE rule.access = 'Allow' AND rule.direction = 'Inbound' AND (rule.source_address_prefix IN ['::/0'] OR any(p IN coalesce(rule.source_address_prefixes, []) WHERE p IN ['::/0'])) SET group.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_ipv6' IN coalesce(group.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN group END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(group.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'direct_ipv6';

MATCH (group:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE group.exposed_internet = true WITH group OPTIONAL MATCH (rule:AzureNetworkSecurityRule)<-[:CONTAIN]-(group) WHERE rule.access = 'Allow' AND rule.direction = 'Inbound' AND (rule.source_address_prefix IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', '::/0', 'Internet'] OR any(p IN coalesce(rule.source_address_prefixes, []) WHERE p IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', '::/0', 'Internet'])) WITH group, collect(DISTINCT {ruleId: rule.id, ruleName: rule.name, port: rule.destination_port_range, protocol: rule.protocol, sourcePrefix: rule.source_address_prefix, sourcePrefixes: rule.source_address_prefixes, priority: rule.priority}) as inboundRules SET group.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: group.id, resourceType: 'azure-networking-networksecuritygroup', context: [{nsgId: group.id, nsgName: group.name, exposureTypes: group.exposed_internet_type, inboundRules: inboundRules, location: group.location}]}])
